verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation such as llms.txt is a fair thing to ask of a SaaS customer-data platform, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows extensive human-oriented docs at docs.mparticle.com, but nothing mentions an llms.txt file, markdown or LLM-friendly doc exports, or documentation written for agents. The marketing mention of describing audiences in natural language is an in-product AI feature, not agent-oriented docs, so it does not count here.
